decision: Treat the earlier Investing.com XRP historical-data page as a generic XRP instrument with unspecified venue, not an OKX venue quote. Preserve the original source shard unchanged and add an explicit correction record that supersedes its venue label.
rationale: Direct page inspection shows the page header '# XRP' and provider 'Investing.com'; no OKX venue is identified. The earlier source record's URL is the generic Investing.com XRP historical-data page. Its 03:41:35 UTC quote and the 06:33:27 UTC quote can be compared only as same-provider observations, not as venue-specific OKX prices.
feature_policy: Do not admit either Investing.com snapshot as a venue-specific feature. Use the same-provider change only as descriptive context. A predictive feature requires source methodology, synchronized multi-venue observations, exact timestamp and independent corroboration.
unresolved: Investing.com market-data aggregation methodology and contributing venues are not disclosed on the inspected page.
Displayed volume denomination and exact daily-row cutoff are not established.
No synchronized cross-venue order-book, trades, CVD, funding, open interest or ETF creation/redemption panel is available.
